verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean's envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell/2) v = exp(∫_{ell/2}^{v} a_net) is the paper's P(v), and reference_uniform_gaussian_bounds states exactly the two outer inequalities with the paper's normalisation (v - L_s/2)^2 / L_s and constants uniform in L_s. The rewriting is only in the last link of the paper's chain: the trailing ≤ 1 is not part of that theorem's conclusion. It follows in one line from the stated upper bound, since -c(v-L_s/2)^2/L_s ≤ 0 and exp is monotone; the repository also states it separately (envelope_lt_one_away_from_midpoint, strict for v ≠ L_s/2, with envelope_at_midpoint giving equality at v = L_s/2). The Lean restricts v to Icc 0 ell, which is the paper's slot.
